tasks.title: Mediate conflicting evidence about a work pilot
tasks.objective: Synthesise conflicting methodological evidence while preserving qualifications and the underlying decision trade-off.
tasks.context:
Note A : après six mois de semaine aménagée, le taux d’absence a baissé dans les équipes volontaires. Les auteurs y voient un indice encourageant, tout en rappelant que les participants avaient déjà moins d’absences que la moyenne.
Note B : les délais de réponse ont augmenté dans deux services. Le rapport précise cependant que leur nouvel outil de suivi comptabilise désormais des demandes auparavant ignorées.
Lors de la réunion, la directrice résume : « Nous disposons enfin de chiffres, mais pas encore d’une comparaison à périmètre constant. » Un représentant répond que différer toute décision reviendrait à faire du doute une politique. Tous deux souhaitent une évaluation plus solide ; ils divergent sur le coût de l’attente. Une synthèse fidèle ne saurait transformer cette divergence pratique en opposition entre science et intuition, ni fondre des indicateurs hétérogènes dans un bilan prétendument unique.

Understand: Track selection effects, measurement changes and the different consequences of uncertainty. Do not infer causation from the absence trend or a real deterioration solely from newly counted requests. Preserve the practical disagreement in mediation.

Language: Ne saurait marks a strongly qualified impossibility in formal prose. Ni… ni… coordinates exclusions. Distinguish reported stance from the narrator’s evaluation.

exercises.prompt: Why is the absence result insufficient to establish a causal effect?
exercises.instructions: Read the French passage. Choose the claim supported by this text, not a broader assumption.
exercises.explanation: The supported interpretation is: Volunteers already differed from the average. Track selection effects, measurement changes and the different consequences of uncertainty. Do not infer causation from the absence trend or a real deterioration solely from newly counted requests. Preserve the practical disagreement in mediation.
options: Volunteers already differed from the average
The pilot lasted no time at all

exercises.prompt: Where do the two speakers chiefly diverge?
exercises.instructions: Read the French passage. Choose the claim supported by this text, not a broader assumption.
exercises.explanation: The supported interpretation is: On the cost of delaying action under uncertainty. Track selection effects, measurement changes and the different consequences of uncertainty. Do not infer causation from the absence trend or a real deterioration solely from newly counted requests. Preserve the practical disagreement in mediation.
options: On whether evaluation has any value
On the cost of delaying action under uncertainty

tasks.objective: Synthesise conflicting methodological evidence while preserving qualifications and the underlying decision trade-off.
tasks.context:
Write a 320–380-word French decision brief synthesising both notes. Explain the two distinct comparability problems, the cost-of-waiting dispute and a conditional next step. Then append a 60-word plain-language summary for staff. Preserve uncertainty without using it to avoid every decision.

Speaking transfer: Mediate the disagreement with the Tutor playing both stakeholders in turn. Reformulate each fairly, then explain your conditional recommendation under questioning.

Revision: Underline every causal claim and identify its evidential basis. Rewrite one technical passage for a non-specialist without losing its qualification.

Self-review: check task fulfilment, evidence, sequence, grammar and spelling. Save a revised version after feedback. AI feedback is advisory; this module check is not a calibrated diagnostic or CEFR level-end examination.
